Package com.github.query4j.optimizer

Interface QueryOptimizer

All Known Implementing Classes:
QueryOptimizerImpl
public interface QueryOptimizer
Main interface for query optimization service that analyzes dynamic queries and provides comprehensive optimization suggestions including index recommendations, predicate pushdown, and join reordering. Implementations must be thread-safe and immutable following the library's design principles.

    • optimize

      OptimizationResult optimize(String sqlQuery)
      Analyzes a SQL query string and returns optimization suggestions. Note: SQL analysis capabilities may be limited compared to QueryBuilder analysis.
      Parameters:
      sqlQuery - the SQL query to analyze, must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      optimization result with suggestions, never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if sqlQuery is null or empty
      OptimizationException - if analysis fails or SQL parsing fails
